purpose: Define the provisional projection route from deviation to distance-like readings and from organized distance-like readings to geometry_app without reintroducing geometry, distance, or metric structure as primitive.

projection_route.reading: Deviation may be projected into a distance-like representation only under declared reference, boundary, orientation, and admissibility metadata. Geometry_app may be read only after distance-like projections are organized and pass the Pi_geo legality gate.

Dev_RT.name: RT Deviation Class
Dev_RT.definition: A process-side departure from null comparison or perfect symmetry under declared RT context.

Pi_dist.name: Deviation-to-Distance-Like Projection
Pi_dist.definition: Projection from declared deviation context to a distance-like representation when reference, boundary, orientation, and admissibility metadata remain recoverable.

Dist_like.name: Distance-Like Projection
Dist_like.definition: A representation of deviation that may support ordering, separation, or locality-like comparison without becoming primitive distance or a metric space.

OrgDist.name: Organized Distance-Like Projection
OrgDist.definition: A set or graph of distance-like projections organized under admissibility, orientation, residue, and trace constraints so it may be submitted to Pi_geo.

geometry_gate.rule: OrgDist may enter the geometry_app projection route only when it can supply the labels required by Dom(Pi_geo): distinction_class, admissibility_status, orientation_class, and closure_class.

appendix_f_disposition.reason: The projection route is now explicit, but validation examples and counterexamples remain required before stronger support.

validation_obligations: Construct a positive trace where Dev_RT projects to Dist_like, organizes as OrgDist, and passes Pi_geo legality.
Construct a counterexample where Pi_dist fails because reference, boundary, orientation, or admissibility metadata is missing.
Construct a counterexample where OrgDist fails Pi_geo because orientation or closure trace is lost.
Determine whether Dist_like admits scalar representation in any bounded subclass without becoming primitive distance.
Audit consistency with Delta evaluation discipline so Pi_dist does not collapse Delta into ordinary distance.
non_promotion_boundaries: Does not define a metric manifold.
Does not promote geometry_app to primitive status.
